name: Kayn
title: the Shadow Reaper

Q.name: Reaping Slash
Q.description: Kayn dashes then spins his scythe, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 + 0.85×bonus AD physical damage to enemies he passes through, then deals the damage again to nearby enemies. Darkin Slayer: Instead deal 0.65×AD plus (6 + 0.035×bonus AD) × 0.01 max Health physical damage.
Q.summary: Kayn dashes, then slashes. Both deal damage.

W.name: Blade's Reach
W.description: Kayn swipes his scythe upward, dealing 85/130/175/220/265 + 1.1×bonus AD physical damage and Slowing enemies hit by (varies)%, decaying over (varies) seconds. Shadow Assassin: Kayn can move while using this Ability and increases its range. Darkin Slayer: Additionally Knocks Up enemies hit for (varies) second.
W.summary: Kayn damages and slows targets in a line.

E.name: Shadow Step
E.description: Kayn gains (varies)% Move Speed, becomes Ghosted, and can move through Terrain for (varies) seconds. When he first enters terrain, he restores 90/100/110/120/130 + 0.45×bonus AD Health. Being Immobilized and spending more than (varies) consecutive seconds outside of Terrain ends this Ability early. Shadow Assassin: Gain (varies)% Move Speed, Slow immunity, and reduce the Cooldown to 10 seconds.

R.name: Umbral Trespass
R.description: Passive: Champions damaged by Kayn are marked for 3.15 seconds. Kayn infests a marked enemy, becoming Untargetable. After 2.5 seconds or after Recasting, Kayn bursts out, dealing 150/250/350 + 1.5×bonus AD physical damage to the enemy. Shadow Assassin: Increases this Ability's range, the distance Kayn exits, and refreshes The Darkin Scythe's Cooldown on exit. Darkin Slayer: Instead deals 0.15 + 0.001×bonus AD max Health physical damage and restores (0.15 + 0.001×bonus AD) × 0.75 Health (75% damage amount).
R.summary: Kayn hides in an enemy's body, dealing massive damage when he bursts out.

Passive.name: The Darkin Scythe
Passive.description: Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin. Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions. Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Shapeshifting jungler who becomes Rhaast (Darkin, bruiser) or the Shadow Assassin. Wins with ganks over walls and R untargetable inside a target.
strengths: E walks through terrain for ganks and escapes
R makes him untargetable inside a marked target for 2.5 s
Q dash spin for clear and chase
W slows; in Rhaast form it also knocks up
Two forms: Rhaast heals from spell damage; Shadow Assassin bursts
weaknesses: Weak until he gets a form (needs orbs from fighting champions)
E ends early if he's immobilized
Low crowd control in Shadow Assassin form
profile.curveNote: Needs E and Q for ganks; form changes his spike.

Passive.notes: Form: Rhaast (heal) or Shadow Assassin (bonus damage).

W.notes: Slow; Rhaast form also knocks up.

E.notes: Terrain walk; heals on entering terrain.

R.notes: Infests a marked enemy, untargetable 2.5 s.

profile.windowAgainst: Before form or R on cooldown.
